title: Health And Safety Manager
description: We are seeking an experienced Health & Safety professional, at Senior Officer or Manager level, to lead occupational health and safety at our terminal operations in Basra, Iraq. This is a hands-on, field-based role for someone comfortable operating in a challenging and complex operating environment, while maintaining close and structured coordination with head office and international financial institutions including the IFC. This role sits within a terminal operation financed in line with international standards, and the successful candidate will be expected to embed IFC Performance Standards (particularly PS2 on Labor and Working Conditions) into day-to-day site practice. Key Responsibilities Lead and manage the terminal's Health & Safety program, ensuring safe execution of all stevedoring activities, cargo handling, lifting, other terminal activities and full compliance with local Iraqi regulations, international maritime/port safety standards, and IFC Performance Standards. Maintain and continuously improve site-level H&S management systems (risk assessments, incident investigation, permit-to-work, emergency response planning, contractor management). Conduct regular field inspections and audits across terminal operations and contractors, identifying hazards and driving corrective action to closure. Build and maintain a strong safety culture among terminal staff, contractors, and third-party operators on site. Prepare clear, high-quality written reports (in English) for head office, shareholders, and IFC/lender reporting requirements — including incident reports, monthly H&S performance data, and periodic compliance updates. Liaise directly with IFC and/or other lenders during site visits, audits, or supervision missions, representing the terminal's H&S performance and improvement plans. Support implementation and continual improvement of the Occupational Health and Safety management system (ISO 45001) and the company health and safety procedures. Support emergency preparedness and response planning specific to the operating context in Basra. Manage relationships with local authorities, regulators, and emergency services as required. Mentor and build capability within the local H&S team over time. Candidate Profile Required: Significant professional experience (with a minimum of 6 years) in occupational health & safety management, ideally within ports, terminals, logistics, heavy industry, oil & gas, or infrastructure sectors. Working knowledge of IFC Performance Standards (particularly PS1 and PS2) and/or Equator Principles-aligned environments. Demonstrated ability to work independently in a demanding field environment while maintaining rigorous reporting discipline back to head office. Excellent written and spoken English — reporting quality and clarity are essential given the audience (shareholders, IFC, lenders). Willingness and ability to relocate to and reside in Umm Qasr, Iraq for a minimum of 2 years. Strong stakeholder management skills, with the composure to engage confidently with senior head office management and external financial institutions. Advantageous: Arabic language skills (spoken). Prior experience working in Iraq or comparable higher-risk/complex operating environments (Middle East, Africa, conflict-affected or post-conflict settings). Recognized H&S qualification (e.g., NEBOSH, IOSH, or equivalent). Experience supporting IFC/DFI site supervision missions or audits.

title: VP/Director of Health Safety, Environmental & Regulatory (HSE&R)
description: TITLE: Vice President / Director of Health Safety, Environmental & Regulatory (HSE&R) Please note: Title and compensation will be assigned commensurate with the candidate’s experience. ABOUT THE COMPANY: W&T Offshore, Inc. (NYSE: WTI) is a thriving, independent oil and natural gas producer operating in the Gulf of America, the second-largest producing basin in the U.S. for nearly four decades. ABOUT OUR EMPLOYEES: We have built a team of talented and collaborative individuals who are committed to cultivating a culture of integrity, honesty, trust, respect, and communication. Our mission is to attract and retain like-minded team members who will grow and prosper within our W&T community. W&T offers a competitive total rewards program designed to provide competitive pay, health and financial benefits, and work-life balance. WORKING LOCATION: Houston Office - 5718 WESTHEIMER RD 7 7057 FULL-TIME/PART-TIME: Full-Time SCHEDULE: Mon -Thurs - 9 hours /Friday - 4 hours (in-office) FLSA STATUS: Salary, Non-Exempt POSITION SUMMARY: Reporting to the COO, The Vice President / Director of Health, Safety, Environment & Regulatory (HSE&R) assumes responsibility for guiding the formulation, execution, administration, and continuous enhancement of the Company's safety and environmental strategies and objectives. This role calls for the delivery of expert guidance in health, safety, environmental and regulatory matters to lead and bolster all levels of the organization’s operations. The VP, HSE&R is hands-on and requires current EHS leadership experience (policies and procedures, processes, system implementations, ESG reporting, compliance, regulatory) specific to the regulatory requirements of the offshore oil and gas industry and a publicly traded company. The role is office-based Mon-Thurs (remote Friday) with up to 15% travel to within the company’s operating area (TX, LA, AL). Primary Responsibilities Manage HSE&R Department, with staff located in Houston (TX), New Iberia (LA), Mobile (AL) and Gulf of America (Offshore). Provide HSE&R leadership to all departments including drilling, completions, operations, production, P&A and construction activities, through leading by example and working constructively with the other department managers and staff. Manage W&T’s regulatory responsibilities for all operations, including preparation and submittal of EPs, DOCDs, permit applications and other filings with BSEE, BOEM and applicable State regulators. Responsible for ESG data collection and reporting. Revise and develop key corporate H&S and environmental policies, programs and procedures and roll them out to all business units and departments through face-to-face and online training. Work with in-house and external attorneys on regulatory enforcement and other legal matters. Represent W&T in Industry groups such as the Offshore Operators Committee and API, and with consortiums such as Clean Gulf Associates and Helix Well Control Group. Manage the company’s HSE compliance programs, including performance tracking and reporting both internally and to regulatory agencies. Track all HSE metrics on a routine basis; develop presentation material for executive management’s use. Direct company HSE/SEMS audits, both internally and externally using contractors and internal compliance technicians. Direct effective incident investigations and review and approve final investigation reports and disseminate the lessons learned. Lead efforts for emergency response training and drills. Continue to implement the computer-based Environmental Management Systems for SEMS and compliance. Manage W&T’s drug testing program. Manage the company’s contractor management program, with ISNetworld and internal processes. Manage and direct W&T’s SEMS program for continuous improvement. Manage waste disposal activities to ensure compliance with RCRA, Alabama, Louisiana and Texas waste regulations. Manage all air permitting activities onshore, including the proper installation of pollution control devices and emissions testing and reporting. Also manage all Greenhouse Gas reporting for offshore and onshore. Knowledge, Education & Experience Bachelor of Science degree in Environmental Management, Science, Engineering or equivalent. 15+ years of hands-on Senior HSE management experience and demonstrated track record managing significant HSE programs in the offshore energy sector. Exceptional leadership, organizational and problem-solving skills. Demonstrated quality decision making skills. Highly effective communication and interpersonal skills with the ability to establish excellent working relationships at both the field and management level. Excellent written and oral communication skills. Proven experience communicating and negotiating with government agencies such as BSEE (MMA), BOEM, USCG and State regulators. Knowledge of applicable regulations that are implemented and enforced by BSEE (MMA), BOEM, USCG, OSHA, EPA, PHMSA, AOGB, APSC, ADEM, TRRC and TGLO. Proven experience managing effective SEMS programs. Strong time management, prioritization, and organizational skills Proficiency with all MS Office products (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, etc.) Self-motivated with the ability to adapt work schedule as needed to accomplish objectives. Knowledge of SempCheck or similar computer-based EMS systems Safety or environmental certification, such as CSP is a plus. Physical Requirements Ability to travel offshore as needed via helicopter and/or boat. Ability to pass all required safety training for offshore travel/work. Requires prolonged sitting, some bending and stooping. Occasional lifting up to 10 pounds. Manual dexterity sufficient to operate a computer keyboard and calculator. title: Security and Infrastructure Engineer
description: About Us Ada is an AI customer service company whose mission is to make customer service extraordinary for everyone. We're driven to raise a new standard of quality customer service at scale, enabling enterprise companies to deliver experiences that people love–instant, proactive, personalized, and effortless. Ada is an AI transformation platform and partner—combining strategic expertise with powerful AI agent management technology to accelerate businesses’ AI maturity to keep them ahead of the curve. With Ada, 83% of customer conversations—and counting—are effortlessly resolved through automation, giving teams more time back, companies more resources to focus on growth, and customers more life to focus on what matters most to them. Established in 2016, Ada is a Canadian company that has powered over 5.5 billion interactions for leading brands like Square, YETI, IPSY, and Monday.com , saving millions of hours of human effort. Backed with over $250M in funding from tier-one investors including Accel, Bessemer, FirstMark, Spark, and Version One Ventures, Ada is a pioneer in the management and application of AI in customer service. At Ada, we see growth as a reflection of each individual owner’s personal growth. That’s why our values are rooted in driving progress and continuous improvement. If you’re ambitious and eager to grow, Ada could be the place for you. Learn more at www.ada.cx . Engineering at Ada As an Ada engineer, you'll have the autonomy to make a huge impact and the opportunity to work alongside talented peers who challenge and inspire you. We move fast, take ownership, and always strive to improve, both as individuals and as a team. As a Security Infrastructure Engineer on Ada's Security Operations team, your work will have a fundamental impact on Ada's growth: our customers put an AI agent in front of their customers, and it has to be trustworthy by construction. Our Role We are looking for a Security Infrastructure Engineer to own cloud and platform security end to end, architecture, detection and response, and platform enablement across AWS and Azure, including the security of our agentic AI platform. This role is not focused on ticket-driven security work: you will replace manual security work with platform capabilities, build guardrails into the product itself, and set the security bar across Product Development. You will operate with a high degree of autonomy, set technical direction that other senior engineers follow, mentor security engineers, and act as the senior technical counterpart to engineering and security leadership translating risk and compliance requirements into concrete engineering solutions. About You 8+ years of experience in cloud, infrastructure, or security engineering roles, including experience setting technical direction across multiple teams, not just executing within one. Deep hands-on experience with at least one major cloud provider, preferably AWS; Azure experience is a plus. Strong experience designing and securing cloud IAM, networking, secrets management, and distributed systems at scale. Extensive experience with infrastructure as code (Terraform or CloudFormation) and policy as code; you default to automation and preventative controls over manual review. Experience building or operating detection and response systems including SIEM, CSPM/CIEM, and cloud security monitoring. Experience with or a strong point of view on securing LLM and agentic AI systems: guardrails, safe tool use, and failure isolation. A track record of turning recurring security and infrastructure requests into self-serve tooling, retiring ticket queues rather than staffing them. Proven ability to translate compliance and risk requirements into technical implementations. Strong communicator who can influence architecture and engineering decisions across teams, and mentor senior engineers through design reviews and hands-on guidance. Comfortable operating independently, owning long-term technical initiatives, and carrying a share of security-relevant on-call. What You Will Do Cloud Security Architecture & Engineering Architect, design, and operate security technologies across cloud, network, identity, endpoint, and application layers in public, private, and hybrid environments. Define cloud security reference architectures, threat models, and guardrails aligned with zero trust and least privilege principles. Own the technical lifecycle of security tooling including cloud-native security services, SIEM, CSPM, CIEM, EDR, DLP, and vulnerability management platforms. Agentic Platform Security Build safety guardrails into the platform itself so failures like an agent bypassing a playbook safeguard cannot reach a customer. Partner with the Reasoning Engine and Playbooks teams on agent behavior that is safe by construction. Set the security bar inside Product Development: secure-coding standards, review practice, and threat modeling for new agentic features. Detection, Response & Automation Stand up security observability: detection, alerting, and response for the platform, wired into Datadog and Sentry alongside the wider observability push. Engineer automated response and remediation workflows using cloud-native automation, SOAR, and infrastructure as code. Lead cloud security incident investigations, carry a share of security-relevant on-call, and feed every incident back into tooling so it does not recur. Self-Serve Security Enablement Turn recurring security and infra requests (access provisioning, environment setup) into self-serve tooling — retire the ticket queue rather than staff it. Embed security into CI/CD pipelines, platform tooling, and deployment workflows using policy as code and automated guardrails, so engineering teams ship faster without compromising security. Governance, Risk & Compliance Enablement Translate security and regulatory frameworks (NIST SP 800-53, PCI DSS, CIS Benchmarks, AWS Well-Architected) into enforceable technical controls. Lead the engineering side of vendor and dependency security: reviews, least-privilege access, and cutting overlapping tools from the stack. Support audits, risk assessments, and evidence collection with internal compliance and external assessors. Technical Leadership Serve as the subject matter expert for cloud and platform security and its relationship to Ada's business-critical systems. Mentor security and platform engineers through documentation, design reviews, and hands-on guidance. Operate with high autonomy, making architectural decisions that shape long-term security posture and platform scalability. Outcomes Own secure-by-default infrastructure for the agentic platform across AWS and Azure: identity, secrets management, network boundaries, and access control. Establish a secure-by-default cloud security architecture that scales with Ada’s growth, reducing risk through automation and preventative controls. Close the guardrail gaps that could let unauthorized agent actions reach a customer. Improve detection, response, and incident readiness across cloud environments. Enable engineering teams to ship faster without compromising security, and raise the bar for security engineering maturity across the organization. First 90 days: map the current attack surface and access model, ship one self-serve replacement for a high-volume manual security request, and close the guardrail gap that let unauthorized actions through. #LI-NS1 Benefits & Perks At Ada, you’ll not only build extraordinary products but also thrive in an environment designed for your success. We prioritize your well-being, growth, and work-life balance. Here’s what we offer: Benefits Unlimited Vacation: Recharge when you need to. Comprehensive Benefits: Extended health coverage, dental, vision, travel, and life insurance. Wellness Account: Empowering you to invest in your overall well-being and lifestyle. Employee & Family Assistance Plan: Resources to support you and your loved ones. Perks Flexible Work Schedule: Balance your work and personal life. Remote-First, In-Person Friendly: Options to work from home or at our local hub. Learning & Development Budget: Invest in your long-term growth goals and skills. Work from Home Budget: Equipping you with the tools and support for a seamless remote work experience. Access to Cutting-Edge AI Tools: Work with the best AI tech stack in the industry. Hands-On with LLMs: Enhance your expertise in leveraging large language models. A Thriving Industry: Join the forefront of innovation in AI, shaping the future of technology. The above Benefits and Perks only apply to full-time, permanent employees. As part of our recruitment process, we may use AI enabled tools to support certain aspects of hiring, such as interview note-taking. All hiring decisions are made by our team. title: Vice President, Global Environmental, Health, and Safety
description: TPI Composites, a trusted, long-term manufacturing partner to the global wind energy market, provides high-quality, cost-effective composite wind blades backed by advanced manufacturing capabilities and our proprietary, AI driven BladeAssure™ validation platform. TPI is headquartered in Scottsdale, Arizona, operates factories in the U.S. and Mexico and has an engineering development center in Denmark with global service operations in the U.S., Mexico, and EU. Job Description Reporting to the Chief Operating Officer, the Vice President, Environmental Health, Safety and Sustainability provides strategic direction and leadership for TPI’s environmental, health & safety programs. The incumbent is responsible for the continuous development and effective implementation of Safety Policies and Procedures. In addition, the incumbent leads the company’s sustainability program. He/she leads a team of safety professionals to drive and ensure a proactive safety culture across the organization as well as best in class sustainability practices. Key stakeholders include regional business leaders, customers as well as the Senior Leadership team at TPI Responsibilities & Accountabilities Drive a proactive safety culture across the organization Design, implement, and continuously improve enterprise-wide environmental, health & safety strategy and programs consistent with industry best practices, Define short and long term objectives to achieve company safety and sustainability goals and implement KPI’s, monthly reporting and business reviews to communicate progress Assess and drive implementation of optimal health & safety organizational structure, tools, training, programs, governance, and accountability models Leads efforts of safety organization through matrix leadership Provide technical expertise and thought leadership, create synergies and leverage knowledge, personnel, best practices, and resources across the organization Support the company’s US Worker’s Compensation Program effectively. This includes a focus on effective case management, return-to-work programs, and similar relative to work related illness and injuries. Ensure compliance with all environmental, health, and safety standards Monitor and facilitate the progress of environmental sustainability programs and governance systems, consistent with strategies, goals, measurements and reporting standards Lead the organization to behave with a sense of urgency, ensure that it is aligned and attracts the best talent Coordinate the executive level engagement between regions, customers and senior stakeholders Leverage synergies across various sites and participates/leads in sharing best practices Coach and mentor supply chain professionals across the organization Create and promote a culture of collaboration, team-work and fun while delivering to or exceeding expectations Who we are looking for: Minimum Education and Experience Bachelor's Engineering Degree in risk management, industrial Safety and Health, Safety engineering, Safety management, or closely related field 10-15 years’ leadership experience in regional or global manufacturing environment Knowledge and expertise in safety requirements in international locations (Americas and Europe) Proven ability to lead diverse safety teams to achieve organizational objectives Experience in the interpretation and enactment of Safety standards in OSHA and other global regulations Demonstrated ability to establish, implement, and manage best practice environmental, health & safety programs Familiarity with ISO 9001/14001/18001 implementation and program sustainability Ability to lead in a matrix environment Highly developed interpersonal communication skills with the ability to effectively, persuasively, and tactfully interact with employees at all levels of the organization. Highly effective presentation and training delivery skills Demonstrated ability to quickly establish credibility and lead by influence across all levels of the organization, from senior leadership to individual contributors This is a remote, U.S.-based role with willingness and ability to travel internationally to manufacturing sites. Build an effective team committed to organizational goals; foster collaboration among team members. Solution oriented, proactive approach and attitude in resolving issues without compromising quality Strong leadership, mentoring, organizational and communication skills Required Skills and Education - 15+ Years Management/Supervision Experience - Leadership experience in global manufacturing operations required Preferred Skills and Education -Experience in global organization -Experience leading teams through impact/influence -Experience in large scale industrial manufacturing

Participate in the preparation of material to enhance awareness on any areas for improvement.
